# require

| Metadata | Value |
|---|---|
| Stable ID | `lua.require` |
| Origin | Lua base |
| Category | Lua Base |
| Family | Function |
| Monaco kind | `function` |
| Format | `require(module_name)` |
| Valid contexts | `file`, `executable` |

## Example
